Gamma flip narrowed to 1110 today from 1120 in the last committed read (07-16) - the short-gamma zone between spot and the flip shrank from 37.6 pts to 14.3 pts in that span, spot outrunning the flip's own upward migration.
Put OI +35.7% over 5 sessions (16,386→22,231) versus call OI +9.7% (11,257→12,347), lifting pc_oi_ratio from 1.46 to 1.80.

S50U26.five_day_thesis: Over the last 5 sessions the S50U26 future rallied 25.7 pts (1070.0→1095.7, +2.4%), clearing the 1080 call wall exactly as the prior squeeze thesis implied, while max pain drifted up only 10 pts (1050→1060) and then stalled there for 3 straight sessions - the spot-to-pain gap widened from 20 to 35.7 pts, worth watching for max-pain-failure risk given the move is confirmed by live volume (229-352 lots) at the 1080-1110 walls rather than fading. The gamma flip itself has migrated up with price but slower than spot: the last committed read (07-16) put it at 1120 with spot 37.6 pts below; today's chain puts it at 1110 with spot only 14.3 pts below, so dealers have stayed net short gamma under spot for the whole window and the squeeze zone has compressed by 23.3 pts. Put OI grew 35.7% (16,386→22,231) against call OI's 9.7% (11,257→12,347) over the same 5 sessions, pushing pc_oi_ratio from 1.46 to 1.80 - protective hedging is being layered on faster than the rally itself, a Protection undertone beneath the Squeeze. ATM IV compressed from 14.40% (07-14) to a 12.98% low (07-17) before a 0.67-pt bounce to 13.65% today, and 25-delta skew flattened from roughly +2.19 (07-16) to +1.12 today as the call side firmed. Net effect: this remains a short-gamma grind higher, not a pin - 70 days to expiry is too far out for near-money OI to magnetize price, and a clean close through 1110 would trigger continued dealer-hedging acceleration rather than reversion toward the 1060 max pain.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1100C / 1130C
strategies.rationale: Dealers are net short gamma below the 1110 flip and the 1080/1100/1110 call-wall complex is showing live volume (229-352 lots today) - a confirmed push through 1110 would force dealer call-buying that historically accelerates the move (07-16's 1080 break played out the same way), and IV at 13.65% keeps the premium comparatively cheap.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit ~13.1 pts (buy 1100C ~24.5 ask, sell 1130C ~11.4 bid) = ~2,620 baht/contract; max gain = 30-pt width - debit = 16.9 pts (~3,380 baht).
strategies.invalidation: A close back below the 1080 call wall, or a slide toward the 1060 max pain, breaks the breakout thesis.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1060P / 1030P
strategies.rationale: Put OI grew 35.7% over 5 sessions (16,386→22,231) versus call OI's 9.7%, lifting pc_oi_ratio to 1.80 - genuine downside-insurance demand building underneath the rally - and IV at 13.65% (near the 5-day low of 12.98%) makes protection cheap to carry.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit ~5.5 pts (buy 1060P ~13.5 ask, sell 1030P ~8.0 bid) = ~1,100 baht/contract; max gain = 30-pt width - debit = 24.5 pts (~4,900 baht).
strategies.invalidation: A sustained close above 1110 (through the gamma flip) without a pullback toward 1060 max pain removes the near-term case for the hedge.

S50U26.prediction: Base case: the short-gamma squeeze continues grinding spot toward and through the 1110 gamma flip / call-wall complex, with dealers likely to keep chasing the move on a confirmed break - next resistance clusters are thin (1120 call OI only 455) up to the 1140 25-delta call band. Invalidation: a reversal back below the 1080 call wall toward the 1060 max pain, especially if put volume and IV pick up on the way down, would flip this from squeeze-continuation to a max-pain-failure-style mean-reversion instead.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice; nothing here is an instruction to open or close a position. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind any wall, gamma flip, or max-pain level are structurally weaker than for share-settled single-stock options - treat every level above as a tendency, not a guarantee. The current 35.7-pt spot-to-max-pain gap already shows price willing to run past the option structure; size any defined-risk position accordingly.
